settings.title: HUD SETTINGS
settings.intro: Choose what the bar HUD shows. The panel always keeps every metric.
settings.showCpu.desc: Show the CPU percentage in the bar.
settings.showMem.desc: Show the RAM percentage in the bar.
settings.showTemp.desc: Show the package temperature in the bar.
settings.showNet.desc: Show the live download rate in the bar.
settings.showDisk.desc: Show the root filesystem percentage in the bar.
settings.showUptime.desc: Show the uptime in the bar.
settings.neon.desc: Use cyan and violet HUD accents instead of the plain theme accent.
settings.intervalHint: Faster sampling makes the graphs more responsive at a small cost in power.
